description: Search airline flights / airfares between two cities by date, cabin class (economy / premium economy / business / first), and number of passengers. Returns available flights from 800+ airlines (Duffel) with real-time pricing, schedules, and stops. Uses IATA airport codes (e.g., MIA, JFK, LAX, LHR). Use this when the user wants to book a flight, fly somewhere, find airfare, or compare airlines.

return_date.description: Return date for round-trip (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for one-way.

name: search_flights
